title: A Forking Knightmare
reviewNotes: Montages, captions and native complete diagrams reviewed. Native61 confirms the complete eleven-piece final board after exd4: White Kd1/Nf8/d3/d4/h3/h5 against Kf5/d5/f6/g5/h6, Black to move. Black has exactly two legal replies: Kf4 or g4. Independent Kf4/Ne6+ permits Kf5/Kg3/Kf3/Ke3, while g4/hxg4+/Kxg4 reaches nine pieces through actual pawn captures. These are independently supplied comparisons, not recovered source moves or certified outcomes. The white h5 pawn is blocked by Black h6; an immediate h6 push is illegal and must not be used to invent a promotion race. Native58–60 support Qe5/Nd4+/Qxd4 with Qxd4 forced to avoid knight mate, but that is not proof of the resulting ending. Retain all remaining pawns and verify both Black root choices and each complete knight/pawn conversion. Prior thirteen-piece draft and review history are preserved; source images/captions remain available.
